name: Cosmic CRF Ltd
title: Cosmic CRF Ltd - 543928 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Installed capacity 133,600 t with ~106,370 t produced (~80%) and FY27 guidance of 122-130k t, but the story leans on Amzen win, unproven margins and rising debt ahead of volume.

capex.quote: we’ve gone up to 55,000 with the investments that we were making

triggers.label: Capacity to 175k t; Amzen adds more
triggers.quote: we will be able to do 175,000 metric tonnes in totality

triggers.label: FY27 capacity 122-130k t
triggers.quote: Next year in FY27 you will have roughly 122,000 to 130,000 metric tonnes of capacity

triggers.label: Spring margin ~2% on INR67 cr
triggers.quote: In that INR67 crores we’ve only made a INR1.5 crore.

triggers.label: Operating cash flow INR3.5 cr
triggers.quote: the cash flow from operations was INR90 crores in negative which has become INR3.5 crores positive

triggers.label: Wagon demand 40-45k/yr call
triggers.quote: So 40,000 wagons to 45,000 wagons at best.

guidance.quote: we will be able to do 175,000 metric tonnes in totality
FY 2029, you should look at total of 350,000 metric tonnes in totality
From where you stand today you are at least looking at 30% higher side.
we do want to grow at the rate that we are growing, which is no less than 100%

prior_guidance_check.quote: we do want to grow at the rate that we are growing, which is no less than 100%

red_flags.label: Operating cash flow near zero
red_flags.quote: the cash flow from operations was INR90 crores in negative which has become INR3.5 crores positive

red_flags.label: Legal and NCLT dispute on Amzen
red_flags.quote: allegations of me individually with my family being under the pretense of debarred

red_flags.label: Related-party style buyout of 26% NSEPL minority
red_flags.quote: for NS Engineering we plan to bring the entire 26% that has been outside

red_flags.label: Spring RDSO licence delay, zero EBITDA
red_flags.quote: we’ve only made a INR1.5 crore. That’s it.

evasions.quote: I will not be able to give you an exact number. And I would not want to give you a number because that’s just unnecessary guidance.
I’m a believer that I’m not in the business of arbitrage.
